basic_details.job_title: CMAML Chief Operating Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Chennai Metro Asset Management Limited (CMAML), a 50:50 joint venture of Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) and Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO), has invited applications for the post of Chief Operating Officer (COO) on contract basis, initially for 3 years. Candidates must be graduates with at least 5 years in a COO or similar leadership role and not less than 10 years in the real estate market, and not more than 55 years of age as on 25-11-2026. how_to_apply: Submit the application strictly in the prescribed CMAML application form, printed on pages 5 to 7 of the notice. Fill it in BLOCK letters with a latest passport size photograph affixed.

Complete the form's sections: personal details, educational qualification, work experience, two references in senior positions at previous workplaces, extra curricular activities, languages known, minimum joining time if selected, and the signed declaration.

Email the duly filled form, supported by Resume / Bio-Data / CV and one set of self-attested copies of educational qualification certificate, experience certificate(s), birth certificate and community certificate, to [email protected].
Also submit the hard copy of the application with the necessary enclosures in a sealed envelope superscribed with "Employment Notification No." and "Post applied for", on or before 18.12.2026.
Address the envelope to: The Chief Executive Officer, (CEO), Chennai Metro Asset Management Limited, METROS, Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai - 600035.
Give a valid email ID in the form. All correspondence from CMAML is sent only to the email ID provided by the candidate.
Email queries may be addressed to [email protected]. CMAML will not be responsible for any delay or loss in postal transit of any application or documentary proof.
Date of Birth Proof: copy of Birth Certificate or 10th Certificate.
Copy of proof of Education Qualifications.
Copy of the detailed Resume / Bio-data / CV.

Self-attested copies of degree / mark sheet / experience certificate of the latest position should indicate the detail, nature, function and job presently being handled. The form also asks for the category to be ticked, with a valid certificate from the appropriate authority enclosed for categories other than General.
important_instructions: Persons already working in Government / PSU organization should apply through proper channel and produce an NOC at the time of interview. Only candidates who provide relevant experience details under Professional experience (Area of work) in the application form are considered for scrutiny. Incomplete applications, or those without relevant supporting enclosures, will be outright rejected. If a candidate is found at any stage not to fulfil the eligibility criteria, or to have furnished incorrect or false information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature is liable to be rejected. If detected after appointment, the services will be terminated without any notice. Candidates attempting to influence or interfere with the selection process will be rejected summarily and declared disqualified for future CMAML recruitments. CMAML reserves the right to cancel, curtail or increase the number of vacancies, to increase or relax the eligibility criteria, and to withdraw the advertised post at any time without assigning any reason. It may fill either the same position or a lower position, or not fill the post. All recruitment related information will be published only on CMRL's website https://chennaimetrorail.org/, and candidates must check it regularly for updates.

content_sections.heading: About CMAML
content_sections.text: CMAML is an infrastructure development and operations company focused on state-of-the-art transit hubs, nodes and property development along the Metro corridors of Chennai. It develops, owns and operates large, fully integrated commercial and office space in Chennai. Its office is at METROS, Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai - 600 035.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Required qualification and experience, as printed in the notice: The incumbent should be a Graduate. At least 5 years in a COO or similar leadership role, preferably in property development / large real estate companies. Good working experience of not less than 10 years in real estate market focused on delivering large-format, institutional, Grade-A asset offerings across India. Strong decision making and analytical abilities. Excellent communication skills. Hands-on experience on investment promotion and marketing launches with a deep insight on similar projects. MBA in any discipline from a reputed institute. The age of the candidate should not be more than 55 years as on the date of notification. The notice also states that age, qualification and experience should be as on 25-11-2026. Age will be relaxed for deserving and experienced candidates only. Only Indian Nationals need to apply. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice prints no salary amount. Salary will be offered on par with the market standards, commensurate with past experience, higher qualification, exceptional credentials, expertise in the relevant field and performance in the interview. In addition, Group Insurance (Personal Accident, Term, Medical), a company car and other admissible allowances shall be paid as per the extant rules of CMAML. The appointment is on contract basis, initially for 3 years. It is extendable by 1 year each for a maximum of 2 years, subject to the requirement and performance of the candidate, or till the age of superannuation (60 years), whichever is earlier. The notice says the extension is as per the existing terms and conditions on mutual consent. Success in the selection process does not confer any right to appointment unless CMAML is satisfied, after such inquiry as it considers necessary, that the candidate's character and antecedents are suitable in all respects.

content_sections.heading: CMAML Chief Operating Officer (COO) Job Description
content_sections.text: The COO is responsible for efficient management and lifecycle optimization of Chennai metro rail assets, for creating, implementing and initiating marketing strategies for promotion of the assets, and for overseeing routine operations. The role involves leading marketing initiatives, driving brand awareness, increasing sales and developing campaigns, so that CMAML assets are promoted through various channels to increase revenue and expand the business. The listed duties are: Develop and execute business development strategies focused on direct interactions with end-clients and indirect sales channels (via IPCs and brokers), to build strong and long-lasting relationships with clients and channel partners. Lead and influence a cross functional team and key stakeholders to drive business growth, strategic partnerships and spearhead business development for the company. Develop pricing and pricing strategies across the segments. Maximize gross contribution at segment and brand level at targeted sales volume. Develop sales and marketing strategies to enhance brand positioning and increase sales velocity. Build relationships with brokers, investors and corporate clients to expand the customer base. Ensure customer satisfaction and post-sales service to maintain brand reputation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMAML Chief Operating Officer (COO)
content_sections.text: Submit the application strictly in the prescribed CMAML application form, printed on pages 5 to 7 of the notice. Fill it in BLOCK letters with a latest passport size photograph affixed. Complete the form's sections: personal details, educational qualification, work experience, two references in senior positions at previous workplaces, extra curricular activities, languages known, minimum joining time if selected, and the signed declaration. Email the duly filled form, supported by Resume / Bio-Data / CV and one set of self-attested copies of educational qualification certificate, experience certificate(s), birth certificate and community certificate, to [email protected] . Also submit the hard copy of the application with the necessary enclosures in a sealed envelope superscribed with "Employment Notification No." and "Post applied for", on or before 18.12.2026. Address the envelope to: The Chief Executive Officer, (CEO), Chennai Metro Asset Management Limited, METROS, Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai - 600035. Give a valid email ID in the form. All correspondence from CMAML is sent only to the email ID provided by the candidate. Email queries may be addressed to [email protected] . CMAML will not be responsible for any delay or loss in postal transit of any application or documentary proof. Date of Birth Proof: copy of Birth Certificate or 10th Certificate. Copy of proof of Education Qualifications. Copy of Experience Certificates. Copy of Community Certificate. Other relevant certificates (if any). Copy of the detailed Resume / Bio-data / CV. Self-attested copies of degree / mark sheet / experience certificate of the latest position should indicate the detail, nature, function and job presently being handled. The form also asks for the category to be ticked, with a valid certificate from the appropriate authority enclosed for categories other than General.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure is based on the personal interview. Merely meeting the qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be shortlisted for interview. Only short-listed candidates will be notified for interview, and CMAML reserves the right to shortlist. To regulate the number of candidates called for interview, if so required, the management reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards / criteria. Provisionally selected candidates need to submit original certificates and other related documents during certificate verification, and will be intimated to appear. No TA / DA will be paid by CMAML to candidates for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Persons already working in Government / PSU organization should apply through proper channel and produce an NOC at the time of interview. Only candidates who provide relevant experience details under Professional experience (Area of work) in the application form are considered for scrutiny. Incomplete applications, or those without relevant supporting enclosures, will be outright rejected. If a candidate is found at any stage not to fulfil the eligibility criteria, or to have furnished incorrect or false information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature is liable to be rejected. If detected after appointment, the services will be terminated without any notice. Candidates attempting to influence or interfere with the selection process will be rejected summarily and declared disqualified for future CMAML recruitments. CMAML reserves the right to cancel, curtail or increase the number of vacancies, to increase or relax the eligibility criteria, and to withdraw the advertised post at any time without assigning any reason. It may fill either the same position or a lower position, or not fill the post. All recruitment related information will be published only on CMRL's website https://chennaimetrorail.org/ , and candidates must check it regularly for updates.
